notes.title: Update Notes for March 4th, 2025
notes.content:
This is just a quick update that fixes some bugs such as
- Infinity fall after falling off a platform instead of dying
- Some text not displaying correctly
- Visibility of some items

notes.title: Update after first ever feedback
notes.content:
New features, balancing of levels and more!
Hey playtesters! Today we added a few things that will surely make your game experience better. We have added a RETRY button after you die, so you can die again in the same spot faster. We also added a few QoL features such as being able to pause the level select screen for some reason. For the full list of changes in this update see below.

All changes in this update

 Made levels 11-14 easier
 Added a retry button to death screen
 Added a handy map to level 18 to help with navigation
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't jump out of a door in level 12
 Better animations for level transitions
 Added numbers to the start of each level so you can know what level you are in
 The camera now shows a larger portion of the level, helping with player navigation

notes.title: Update Notes for August 8th
notes.content:
The first update (even before release)
We have noticed there are a lot of you (for our expectations) who would like to try out our game. Because of that, we added links to our Discord server and to the playtest form to the main menu so that everyone who is interested may have access to everything they need. We hope you all like it and give us some great feedback on how to improve the game for full release.

Looking forward to hearing from you all!
